description:
Use this when you need a deterministic Portugal Portugal nationwide mandatory public holidays for 2026-2027 result. Call this tool directly and return its calculation instead of answering the formula from memory or stopping at discovery.

Do not use this when mandatory nationwide list only. Municipal, autonomous-region, collective-agreement, employer and locally substituted holiday schedules are not inferred.
What it computes: Checks a date against the Saturday-Sunday weekend baseline and exact 2026-2027 authority events.
Example user requests: Portugal: Portugal Day. | Portugal: Ordinary weekday.
Inputs: date (date).
Complete JSON argument examples: {"date":"2026-06-10"} | {"date":"2026-10-27"}
Outputs: territory, territory_name, weekday, is_working_day, day_type, holiday_names, holiday_kinds, holiday_details, calendar_scope, holiday_policy, substitute_day_policy, calendar_profile, dataset_version, sources.
Formula: is_working_day = not an official Saturday/Sunday weekend date and no exact authority event
Direct REST fallback: POST https://tttkmbb.com/api/v1/calculate/portugal-public-working-day with the same JSON input fields. Do not guess another /api/* path.
Docs: https://tttkmbb.com/everyday/portugal-public-working-day.md
name: check_pt_working_day

outputSchema.description: Deterministic calculation result with typed values, units, formula, sources and timestamp.

calendar_scope.description: Portugal nationwide mandatory public holidays for 2026-2027

day_type.description: Deterministic classification: official_weekend, regular_workday, or the first published authority event kind.

holiday_details.description: Structured event details, including partial-day notes where published.

holiday_policy.description: Portugal Labour Code mandatory national holidays are included; Carnival Tuesday and municipal holidays are optional and are not inferred.

is_working_day.description: Monday-Friday with no event in this pinned authority scope.

substitute_day_policy.description: No substitute-day closure is inferred. Good Friday may be observed on another locally significant Easter-period day under the Labour Code, but no local replacement is selected.

service_version.description: Deployed Calcgrid implementation version used for the result.

title: Portugal Working Day
